subject: stf
title: STF.------POL.DY.
description: Second diagram on page 430, paired with (R)SG × TR above. Where the first diagram structurally shows how the sixties' source-generation terminated in political-dynamism rather than transformation, this one picks up exactly that POL-DY output as the partner-axis of a new crossing: (C)STF (central structural-formal phenomenon — the *form* of sixties activism as it actually constituted itself) crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics — the working political reality of that activism). STF sits centrally with the subject-arrow; CN-INFO (continuance-information) sits just above it as the form's information-hub, with ALT-D (alternative definitions) on the left feeding down to MT-INFO (meta-information) at the bottom-left, and AF-NT (affinity natural) on the right of CN-INFO. TRS hangs below STF as the subject's downward terminus. POL-DYM (political dynamism — the prior diagram's terminus) anchors the upper-left as partner-axis; INT (intention) rises at top-center and TM (the matrix term) sits centrally on the partner side, with ALT-F (alternative form) at the top-right and SOC-RT-P (social-reality-particular) on the right margin. Structural argument: when sixties structural-form is crossed with political-dynamics, the partner's upper chain (POL-DYM → INT → TM → ALT-F / SOC-RT-P) is the actual political route — intention routes through the matrix into alternative-form and social-reality-particular. But the subject's CN-INFO routes the form's own information through ALT-D into MT-INFO on the *subject's* bottom-left, never reaching the partner's TM. The diagonal that would let AF-NT cross to TM (the only edge that could make affinity-natural appear in the political-matrix) is exactly what sixties activism could not hold — and so the structural-form's TRS terminates as a subject-side output without crossing back to the partner's alternative-form. The prose's argument that the sixties' significance lies in what comes next — 'transitional functionalism of the second degree as this consideration will apply to extended multi-functionalism in the coming periods' — is structurally a claim about needing that AF-NT/TM diagonal to actually be held in the next cycle.
